description: Test file for EndpointSlice getter implementations in Kubernetes proxy package, verifying correct retrieval and synchronization of EndpointSlice objects across different phases and namespaces.

methods.name: makeEndpointSlice
methods.description: Creates a new EndpointSlice object with specified namespace, service, slice index, and IP address.

methods.name: assertSlices
methods.description: Asserts that the EndpointSlices retrieved match the expected slices for a given namespace and service.

methods.name: testGetter
methods.description: Runs a series of tests on the EndpointSliceGetter to verify correct behavior during create, update, delete, and sync phases.
